verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own documented Vault Health Reports evaluate vault security, and the evidence names Reused Passwords and Weak Passwords reports run locally on the client. That covers the weak and reused parts of the story. The pack says nothing about breached-service or exposed-credential detection, and it shows these as reports the user runs on demand rather than proactive warnings. Missing for 10: breached-service/data-breach alerts, exposed-password detection, proactive in-app warnings rather than manually run reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed

citations.quote: Vault health reports can help you evaluate the security of your Bitwarden individual or organization vault. Reports, such as the Reused Passwords and Weak Passwords report, are run locally on your client
